top_signals.title: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic's Mythos
top_signals.summary: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch software flaws exposed by Anthropic’s Mythos, offering a rare look at costs involved in defending against AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BofA Takes US Regulatory Fines Seriously, CEO Moynihan Says
top_signals.summary: Bank of America Corp. Chief Executive Officer Brian Moynihan addresses the $1.2 billion in fines levied against the company by the US government. He says the bank takes the fines seriously and there is accountability at the firm. He says costs associated with these fines are in the company "baseline." He speaks to Bloomberg's Jonathan Ferro. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cargo Ship Sinks in Strait of Hormuz After Strike Triggers Fire
top_signals.summary: A cargo ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz after a strike that sparked a fire and the evacuation of crew members, the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore said.
